GROUP BY template.template_id, template.template_code, template.name, template.description, template.field_definitions_json, template.status, template.row_version, template.created_by, template.created_at, template.updated_by, template.updated_at
ORDER BY template.template_code, template.template_id
ORDER BY template.updated_at DESC, template.template_id
ORDER BY template.created_at DESC, template.template_id
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT template.template_id, template.template_code, template.name, template.description, template.field_definitions_json, template.status, COALESCE(MAX(version.version_number), 0) AS latest_version_number, template.row_version, template.created_by, template.created_at, template.updated_by, template.updated_at FROM policy_template template LEFT JOIN policy_version version ON version.template_id = template.template_id WHERE template.template_id = #{templateId} GROUP BY template.template_id, template.template_code, template.name, template.description, template.field_definitions_json, template.status, template.row_version, template.created_by, template.created_at, template.updated_by, template.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_template ( template_id, template_code, name, description, field_definitions_json, status, row_version, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{templateId}, #{templateCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{fieldDefinitionsJson}, #{status}, #{rowVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT version_id, template_id, version_number, status, parameters_json, effective_from, effective_to, change_reason, validation_json, snapshot_json, snapshot_digest, rollback_of_version_id, row_version, created_by, created_at, published_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM policy_version WHERE template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY version_number DESC, version_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT version_id, template_id, version_number, status, parameters_json, effective_from, effective_to, change_reason, validation_json, snapshot_json, snapshot_digest, rollback_of_version_id, row_version, created_by, created_at, published_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM policy_version WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_version ( version_id, template_id, version_number, status, parameters_json, effective_from, effective_to, change_reason, validation_json, snapshot_json, snapshot_digest, rollback_of_version_id, row_version, created_by, created_at, published_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{versionId}, #{templateId}, #{versionNumber}, #{status}, #{parametersJson}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{changeReason}, #{validationJson}, #{snapshotJson}, #{snapshotDigest}, #{rollbackOfVersionId}, #{rowVersion}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE policy_version SET parameters_json = #{version.parametersJson}, effective_from = #{version.effectiveFrom}, effective_to = #{version.effectiveTo}, change_reason = #{version.changeReason}, validation_json = #{version.validationJson}, status = 'DRAFT', snapshot_json = NULL, snapshot_digest = NULL, row_version = #{newVersion}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE template_id = #{version.templateId} AND version_id = #{version.versionId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'VALIDATED') AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT binding_id, version_id, scope_type, scope_resource_id, priority, effective_from, effective_to, row_version FROM policy_scope_binding WHERE version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY priority DESC, scope_type, scope_resource_id, binding_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_scope_binding ( binding_id, version_id, scope_type, scope_resource_id, priority, effective_from, effective_to, row_version ) VALUES ( #{bindingId}, #{versionId}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeResourceId}, #{priority}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{rowVersion} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT other_version.version_id AS conflicting_version_id, candidate.scope_type, candidate.scope_resource_id, candidate.priority, candidate.effective_from, candidate.effective_to FROM policy_scope_binding candidate JOIN policy_version candidate_version ON candidate_version.version_id = candidate.version_id JOIN policy_scope_binding other ON other.scope_type = candidate.scope_type AND other.scope_resource_id = candidate.scope_resource_id AND other.priority = candidate.priority AND other.version_id <> candidate.version_id AND other.effective_from <= COALESCE(candidate.effective_to, DATE '9999-12-31') AND COALESCE(other.effective_to, DATE '9999-12-31') >= candidate.effective_from JOIN policy_version other_version ON other_version.version_id = other.version_id AND other_version.template_id = candidate_version.template_id AND other_version.status = 'PUBLISHED' WHERE candidate_version.template_id = #{templateId} AND candidate_version.version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY other_version.version_id, candidate.scope_type, candidate.scope_resource_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_publication_record ( publication_id, template_id, version_id, action, reason, actor_id, request_id, result, occurred_at, snapshot_digest ) VALUES ( #{publicationId}, #{templateId}, #{versionId}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{actorId}, #{requestId}, #{result}, #{occurredAt}, #{snapshotDigest} )

INSERT INTO policy_rollback_record ( rollback_id, template_id, source_version_id, target_version_id, created_version_id, reason, actor_id, request_id, result, occurred_at ) VALUES ( #{rollbackId}, #{templateId}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{targetVersionId}, #{createdVersionId}, #{reason}, #{actorId}, #{requestId}, #{result}, #{occurredAt} )

INSERT INTO audit_event ( event_id, occurred_at, actor_id_ref, actor_type, action_code, resource_type, resource_id_ref, result_code, reason_code, policy_version, before_digest, after_digest, correlation_id, request_id, event_hash ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{occurredAt}, #{actorId}, 'USER', #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{result}, #{reason}, #{policyVersion}, #{beforeDigest}, #{afterDigest}, #{requestId}, #{requestId}, #{eventHash} )
